text:
maya: Quick sync — Sparkline launch next week. Need final for launch post, webinar plan, credit ladder, starter-kits (prompt templates), and inbound routing.
liam: schedule?
maya: Post Mon AM, webinar Tue 10am PT, credits go out Wed evening.
sam: primary metric = first-5-requests activation within 24h. secondary = D7 retention.
anya: baseline activation 22%. goal +12pp.
rachel: creative idea: show 3 micro-templates inline and a one-click "Try" button. Keep social copy <200 chars.
liam: routing rule suggestion: route to SDRs if company_size>=30 OR requests private/dedicated OR mentions compliance. otherwise self-serve + nurture.
maya: ops: can we make the threshold 30 for this experiment (differs from usual 50)?
ops-bot: routing rule queued: {"if":"company_size>=30 OR interest contains 'private' OR 'compliance'","route":"sales-sdr"} deployed to routing-service.
sam: landing should include a 3-template starter-kit: support-bot, doc-summarizer, dev-helper. template_run event to measure usage.
anya: add header A/B test: A) "Ship faster with starter templates + $20" B) "Try Sparkline: instant templates, instant credit" — 50/50.
rachel: webinar format: 8m product intro, 25m live prompt duel (two use-cases), 12m Q&A. incentive: extra $10 if attendee completes 3 live runs.
liam: finance ok?
maya: finance signed off on $4k promo pool. per-account cap = $40.
ops-bot: promo bucket 'sparkline-webinar-2026' created. webhook /promo/claim ready, idempotency key required.
sam: analytics: emit template_run {template_id, run_index, tokens, success}. also track signup_source and variant.
maya: experiments: 1) header A/B 50/50. 2) sdr_probe = 12% for low-fit leads to route to SDRs. monitor lift and cost.
liam: can we also experiment with two microcopies for CTA: "Try w/ $20" vs "Start with templates"?
anya: yes, add as nested micro A/B on the landing button.
ops-bot: experiment flags: header_ab=50/50, sdr_probe=12%, cta_micro=50/50.
rachel: drafting copy now, visuals ETA tomorrow morning.
sam: I'll seed starter-kit and wire telemetry to dashboard. evaluation plan ready to compare to baseline after 48h.
maya: QA checklist: signup -> claim -> auto-credit -> run template -> template_run event -> credits consumed UI. test idempotency and per-account cap.
liam: noted, will update SDR handoff doc and routing playbook.
maya: perfect — I'll post a recap with ticket links and timelines. :sparkles:
